description: This file implements the FrameRate plugin for a media or display system, managing frame rate collection, event handling, and interfacing with video devices and IARM bus events.

classes.name: FrameRate
classes.description: A plugin class managing frame rate collection, event notifications, and device interactions.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, including IARM bus registration.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unregisters event handlers.

methods.name: setCollectionFrequencyWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for setting the frame rate collection frequency via JSON RPC.

methods.name: startFpsCollectionWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to start FPS collection.

methods.name: stopFpsCollectionWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to stop FPS collection.

methods.name: updateFpsWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to update the current FPS value.

methods.name: setFrmMode
methods.description: Sets the frame mode on the video device.

methods.name: getFrmMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current frame mode from the video device.

methods.name: setDisplayFrameRate
methods.description: Sets the display frame rate on the video device.

methods.name: getDisplayFrameRate
methods.description: Gets the current display frame rate from the video device.

methods.name: getCollectionFrequency
methods.description: Returns the current FPS collection interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: setCollectionFrequency
methods.description: Sets the FPS collection interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: startFpsCollection
methods.description: Starts FPS collection timer and data gathering.

methods.name: stopFpsCollection
methods.description: Stops FPS collection timer and reports collected data.

methods.name: updateFps
methods.description: Updates the current FPS value and tracks min/max/average.

methods.name: fpsCollectionUpdate
methods.description: Sends a notification with the current FPS statistics.

methods.name: onReportFpsTimer
methods.description: Timer callback to report FPS statistics periodically.

methods.name: FrameRatePreChange
methods.description: Handles pre-change event for display frame rate.

methods.name: frameRatePreChange
methods.description: Notifies about display frame rate pre-change.

methods.name: FrameRatePostChange
methods.description: Handles post-change event for display frame rate.

methods.name: frameRatePostChange
methods.description: Notifies about display frame rate post-change.
